subject: robust indices with WLSMV in multigroup CFA

messages.author: 15b83800b6e91096
messages.subject: robust indices with WLSMV in multigroup CFA
parts:
Hi all - I'm working on a measurement invariance issue using WLSMV given the nature of the data/how the scale was constructed.

Using WLSMV produces two columns of fit indices, and reading other posts in the group, I've seen that the "Robust" column is what ought to be used in interpretation. However, when I test scalar invariance, group.equal = c ("thresholds", "loadings"), the CFI and TLI values on the robust column are about .82 and .81 respectively. In the column to the left, they are .955 and .949.

The model statement, more specifically is:

model3fit <- cfa(model = cfa62m, data, group="intl", parameterization = "theta", estimator ="WLSMV", group.equal=c("loadings", "thresholds"))


I'm having a hard time finding a means to understand this clear dip in fit indices and if any insight is available, I'd love to learn why this is the case! Thanks.

messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: robust indices with WLSMV in multigroup CFA
parts: I'm having a hard time finding a means to understand this clear dip in fit indices

There is no "dip".  The ones on the left are simply computed using the chi-squared values in the left column, which are different than the ones in the robust column.
